evidence.quote: The master Q-former model is a 6-layer InstructBLIP-style [19] Q-Former that fuses the Stage 1 modality-specific tokens with a natural-language instruction, and produces 32 refined query tokens for the LLM.

At each forward pass the meta-query tokens and the tokenised instruction are concatenated into a single sequence; the query tokens cross-attend with both the instruction tokens and self-attend with each other (mimicking the InstructBLIP concatenation trick), and cross-attend to the layer-normalised Stage 1 visual tokens every two transformer layers.

decisions.rationale: R3: the Master Q-former is explicitly described with self-attention among queries and cross-attention to instruction and Stage 1 visual tokens.
